@POTUS For the umpteenth time for very good reason, We the People say:

Declare a #ClimateEmergency NOW & be more proactive on #ClimateChange mitigation & adaptation!

⏰🌎🚨

No more half-measures & bad steps with good steps; #EndFossilFuels, deforestation & unsustainable agriculture.

@ajeansu @POTUS Yes, Mr. President, now is the time to responsibly declare a #ClimateEmergency as it has been since you took office with the help of so many of us across the country who act & volunteer in the urgent roles #ClimateVoter-s!
